meta.note: 'verified' means the value comes from a cited source. 'qatar_specific' means it was measured for Qatar. The API warns whenever a factor is not Qatar-specific.

grid_electricity.source: IEA (2025), as listed in ABB '2025 Electricity Emission Factors' (Qatar: 460.6 gCO2/kWh)

heat.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 2 Ch. 2 default for natural gas: 56,100 kg CO2/TJ (= 0.0561 kg CO2/MJ), net calorific basis

swro.source: Midpoint of 3.7-4.5 kWh/m3 for seawater reverse osmosis, from a published review table of desalination energy use.

med.source: Multi-effect distillation: 2 kWh electricity + 263 MJ heat per m3, same review table.

msf.source: Multi-stage flash: 4 kWh electricity + 333 MJ heat per m3, same review table.
